source_slug: 2025-12-22 Smart Paper Technology is Transforming Community Health Data Capture in The Gambia

fact: DHIS2 has been used as Gambia's national health management information system since 2009, DHIS2 says.
WAHO's workshop brings together Gambia's national health information system managers, and the pilot aligns regional indicators with its national DHIS2 system.
